profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI at Metrc
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with a strong focus on building scalable systems and modern cloud-native applications.
My recent work involves building LLM-powered systems, including tool-based integrations, evaluation workflows, and AI-assisted development practices.
I have experience across backend development, distributed systems, and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, with an emphasis on reliability, scalability, and production ownership.
I’m interested in continuing to grow in applied AI and building systems where AI is integrated into real-world workflows.
